title: More room in the image queue
summary:
Image queues got more room, image responses got clearer usage details, and the community project list grew.

Nanobanana and Seedream queues moved from 45-second to 30-second intervals. Flower users can make up to 3 requests per interval and Nectar users up to 6, instead of the previous cap of 1 for everyone. The `gemini` text model also switched to Vertex AI.

Image responses gained headers for the model used, user tier, and completion image tokens, with tracking preserved through conversion and resizing. Enter added Nanobanana and Seedream to its image model registry, while Flux Kontext and Turbo gained explicit per-image prices. Flux remains priced at zero.

Enter corrected its Pollen balance display and checkout return URL, and added GPT-5 Chat to its text usage registry. Text requests that need a signed-in session now give a more specific message. The text API root also gained a permanent redirect to its documentation.

highlights.title: See which image model ran
highlights.text: Image API responses now include `x-model-used`, `x-user-tier`, and `x-completion-image-tokens` headers, so you can inspect the model and usage behind a generated image. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
